description: Advancing Knowledge on the Performance of Seismic Collectors in Steel Building Structures is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Robert Fleischman, University of Arizona (arizona.edu). To safely survive an earthquake, and thereby protect its occupants, contents, adjacent property, and passersby, a building structure must transfer the large forces that develop during the earthquake from within the building down to the foundation. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Steel Seismic Collector Connections , Large Scale Tests, Seismic Collectors , Steel Seismic Collectors. Published 2026-01-28. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
